notes: Torah #232 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The dataset contains no edges at all for reference=232. The packages file also contains zero packages. The Torah teaches that when reciting 'Hallelu et Hashem min hashamayim,' the person calls upon all the worlds to praise God, and from this one should be aroused to pray with kavvanah (intention of the heart). The causal structure is: reciting Pesukei DeZimra -> calling all worlds to praise -> awareness of this should arouse -> prayer with kavvanah. This is a purely eitza teaching with no bechina language, and none was encoded in the dataset.
